Fields.Name: Elbow Axis
Fields.Description: The axis the elbow bends around, in the elbow's space.

Fields.Name: Back Of Hand Normal
Fields.Description: The direction the back of the hand faces, in the wrist's space.

Fields.Name: Hand Offset
Fields.Description: An offset from the wrist to the point placed on the target.

Fields.Name: Hand Orientation Offset
Fields.Description: A rotation offset of the hand.

Fields.Name: Max Elbow Angle
Fields.Description: The most the elbow can bend, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Min Elbow Angle
Fields.Description: The least the elbow can bend, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Shoulder Sibling Bone
Fields.Description: A bone that follows the shoulder. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Elbow Sibling Bone
Fields.Description: A bone that follows the elbow. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Enforce End Position
Fields.Description: Whether the hand reaches the target position exactly.

Fields.Name: Enforce End Rotation
Fields.Description: Whether the hand takes the target rotation exactly.

Fields.Name: Local Frame Name
Fields.Description: A local frame of the hand placed on the target. Empty: the wrist.
